campaign.title: M2 BAL joint cluster-defect broad--narrow gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No theorem-name continuation. A source may be used only after its exact statement, coefficient class, norm direction, parameter range, and literal kernel map are audited. The primary objective is a direct joint signed derivation.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete signed divisor-progressive bulk kernel K_B^bulk be split into a genuinely transverse broad part and arithmetic aligned-ruling narrow parts, with the broad and every narrow contribution together bounded by L^(3+epsilon), while retaining both chi_4 factors, both low-gcd weights, literal slanted profiles, distinct divisor lifts, both far gates, real-centre phases, crossings, and the fixed-block owner; if not, what is the first exact transversality, cluster, arithmetic-sign, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: K_B=sum_(h odd,k,k') b_B(h,k) sum_(d|k', d odd) gamma_d sum_J sum_(mu in Z+1/2, mu>0, t_* in J) A_(d,J)(h,k,k';mu)e(Theta_(d,mu)), where lambda=mu/d, x_*=Xk'/lambda^2, Theta=R sqrt(hk)-Xk'/(2lambda)-lambda h/2+s_d(1/2-lambda), and the target is |K_B^bulk|<<_epsilon L^3 X^epsilon for L asymp X^(1/6).
quantities: h'=h+2s=d(ell_d+2t), s=s_d+dt, h+2s_d=d ell_d, d odd, mu=1/2-m, lambda=mu/d
mu asymp dL^3 with spacing one, lambda spacing 1/d, stationary amplitude O((dL)^(-1)), and O(L^3) outer triples
rho=hk'-x_*k=[hk'/lambda^2](lambda^2-lambda_0^2) and Delta=x_*k'-hk=[hk/lambda^2](lambda_r^2-lambda^2), with both strict far gates |rho|>L and |Delta|>L retained
the residue phase s_d(1/2-lambda), divisor coefficient gamma_d, and lift label (d,mu) are literal; equal rational lambda from distinct lifts may not be merged

all finite-Poisson boundary, transition, support-crossing, nonstationary, and stationary-remainder packages are already target-safe at O_epsilon(L^3X^epsilon); the frozen question concerns only the interior bulk
the phase-free mode is already target-safe only after full signed assembly

aliaswise l1, one-frequency reciprocal counting, coefficient-uniform spacing large sieves followed by outer norms, a second one-variable B-process, and positive row energy as an equivalent scalar target are parked controls

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact K_B^bulk index set, amplitude, phase, divisor progression, both far gates, and owner ledger before estimating.
Define an explicit broad--narrow partition using joint phase-gradient, slope, or rational-cluster data at a stated resolution; no qualitative use of the words broad or narrow is accepted.
For the broad part, prove the required transversality or determinant lower bound and price every Cauchy, TT*, decoupling, large-sieve, or oscillatory step back to L^3.

For every narrow part, classify the aligned rational ruling in the literal (d,mu,h,k,k') variables and use the actual chi_4 and residue phases, or construct a lawful actual-symbol coherent obstruction.
Keep distinct divisor lifts, the two coupled gates, all smooth profiles, fixed-centre phase, and boundary ownership until a proved inequality permits removal.
Test the mechanism on diagonal, same-rational-lambda, same-denominator, phase-adapted, opposite-character, and gate-boundary packets.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_joint_reduction, or broad_narrow_no_go.
Make no BAL parent, M9-M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or global-exponent promotion unless the complete literal L^3 estimate and all graph dependencies are proved.

review_seams.requirement: The exact divisor-progressive bulk kernel, actual amplitudes, distinct lifts, phase, gates, and owner ledger are reproduced before estimating.
Broadness is defined at an explicit scale and yields a proved determinant or transversality lower bound with a complete L-power ledger.
Every failure of transversality is classified as a literal arithmetic ruling and estimated using actual signs or exposed as an unresolved lawful packet.
No coefficient-uniform positive energy, row Gram, or aliaswise modulus is substituted for the fixed-block signed scalar.
Same-lift, equal-rational-lambda, phase-adapted, opposite-character, and gate-boundary controls are all tested.
Only the balanced double-far bulk owner may change; BAL, other M2 owners, endpoints, M9, and global exponents require separate closure.

closing_assessment.main_result: The combined linear/residue term exactly restores -i(-1)^m chi_4(d)chi_4(h); equal-rational lifts have a common full carrier and common gates but distinct amplitudes. Raw gradient vectors, gradient-surface normals, and one-body Hessians are different determinant objects, and none has the missing fixed-block scalar interface. Gauge-robust fixed-Q rulings survive both strict gates, while positive capacities remain one factor L above target. The standard broad--narrow mechanism is parked without disproving BAL.
